literal_meaning: ধরা (caught) + শায়ী (lying down); caught and laid flat
figurative_meaning_en: Fallen to the ground or brought low
example_sentences_in_bangla: গরুর গুঁতোয় সে ধরাশায়ী হয়ে গেল।
যুদ্ধে পরাজিত হয়ে তারা ধরাশায়ী হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He was knocked down by the bull's horn.
They were brought low after the defeat in battle.
history: Originates from rural incidents involving bulls goring people, common in traditional Bengali agrarian society.
note: Often used metaphorically for defeat or downfall in various contexts.
